finding_in_progress: Characteristic-7 route found, not yet frozen. In a P7 configuration at most one cofactor is even and at most one is divisible by 7. Hence at least six subgroups have odd index with v_7=1, and by the frozen Lemmas 1-2 (d2af4a0d) at most one of them lies in a proper parabolic. Classical groups in characteristic 7: Maslova's published odd-index maximal-subgroup classification (arXiv:1710.01563v3, pinned) leaves no non-parabolic odd-index maximal subgroup with v_7(index)=1, except S4<PSL2(7) and PGL2(7)<PSL2(49). Exceptional groups in characteristic 7: BBGT Theorem 2(iii)/Table C gives a prime r>7 with a unique maximal overgroup of a Sylow r-subgroup, hence three-index exclusion. The author's kernel factored Phi_n(7) for the small-f size conditions.
